description: Rules that decide which inventory conditions become actionable attention items. Edit this file to tune the board without changing tools/generate_attention.py.

publicLinks.note: An app without an App Store page is only a problem if the app has actually shipped. Statuses that have not shipped, or are deliberately never shipping, are not flagged.

recentChange.note: Without a watermark this degrades to a single digest card instead of one card per changed entry, so the board never becomes a git log.

tasks.note: A task is only overdue if a real run has been recorded. Cadence alone cannot make something due, or every task is permanently due.

gaps.note: Only gaps explicitly dispositioned 'open' become cards. 'resolved' is history and 'accepted' is a recorded decision.
